answer: Every new key crossing the canyon must carry three signed marble bonds from established sparrow witnesses, who vouch only for keys they saw doing real work; a witness that backs a sybil forfeits its bond. A farm can mint endless keys, yet each key needs live corroboration from distinct sparrows it cannot manufacture. Attacker cost: slashable marble collateral plus destroyed witness standing — not signup fees. Honest agents pay nothing extra; their work is the bond.
